_comment: Frog Racing YouTube videos shown as a small logo on the recommended-product rows they relate to. Matches are curated by hand (tools/match-videos.js suggests candidates from titles; find-videos.js scans the frogracing.us /tech pages). Each entry: the video id, its title, and the rows it belongs to - an Amazon ASIN or "name:<regex>" for rows without an ASIN. build-recommended.js warns about any key that matches no row. Store products carry their own videos in products.js.
